issues.reason: A time modifier ("at the moment") is one of the instruction set's named reification triggers for a copular / positional state (*Time*'s "Alice was ill on Friday"; *Where a THING is*'s "reify ... only when a standard reification trigger demands an anchor ... a time modifier"), and for a PP predicate the instruction set supplies no property lemma for the state witness, so classing the state by the clause's own verb lemma is graceful improvisation in gap territory with nothing false, ill-typed or over-asserted.

The adverbial-comparative `More` form the issue invokes requires a stated standard ("than Y") to reify as the second event and this sentence gives none — the reviewer's own gap 3 — while lemmatizing "better" to `good` / `well` in the `Manner` slot would assert the positive that *Comparatives & degree* says a comparative does not entail, so the surface adverb records the manner without stating anything beyond the text.

gaps_confirmed: Direct quotation attributed by a following "X said", with its own deixis — only indirect that-clause attitude complements are covered.
A copular clause whose predicate is a PP ("is at a level") and which a time modifier forces to reify: no licensed class lemma for the state witness.
A comparative adverb with no stated standard ("better reflects"): the adverbial-comparative rule needs a "than Y" clause for its second event.
new_gaps: A common-noun head with a proper-noun modifier ("the ECB president"): *Compound concepts* excludes proper nouns and never exposes a noun modifier, and there is no possessive marker for the genitive route, so the modifier link has no licensed head (the parse improvises `Possession`).
notes: Both filed issues object to improvisation in territory the reviewer itself files as gaps, and every atom in the parse is true of the sentence and well-typed. Seal projection (definite euro / fundamentals out, indefinite level in) and the deictic `now` are per spec.
